assets.role: 海边工作台背景；手机端作为独立插画展示
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Transform the attached character reference sheet into a polished wide 16:9 illustration for the hero background of 大肥鱼's personal configuration website. Use the reference only as character identity, NOT a sheet layout. Preserve long wavy deep blue hair fading to cyan, blue eyes, whale-shaped ears, navy whale tail, white frilled maid headband, navy blue and white maid dress with small blue ribbons. Adult anime whale girl, cheerful gentle slightly cheeky personality. Scene: her cozy sky-blue workstation by a circular window overlooking a pale blue sea, sitting on the RIGHT THIRD of the frame, leaning her cheek on one hand, waving with the other, tiny plush blue whale on desk, a few floating ocean bubble and star motifs. Editorial anime illustration with crisp outlines, soft pastel cell shading, clean high detail, cute but not overly busy. The LEFT HALF must be light pale sky blue spacious negative space with only very faint cloud and sea details, suitable for dark blue website text. Right edge full illustrated character, no text, no typography, no UI, no cards, no watermark. Palette: deep cornflower blue, icy sky blue, creamy white, small butter-yellow accents. Aspect ratio landscape 16:9.
